'''Kahrin Wek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]] on the ruined planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], she proved her superior [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gardit]]'s corruption with the help of a Republic-allied individual.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Kahrin Wek joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] sometime before [[3643 BBY]]. She served on the ruined [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the later stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], where she was stationed at [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]].<ref name="Supplies" />

Wek served as [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gardit]], the base's commanding officer. In that role, she ensured that the Republic's forward bases, like [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]] and [[75th Legion forward camp|Camp Lytle]], received the necessary supplies.<ref name="Supplies" /> However, Wek suspected her superior to be corrupt&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|human]] used his position to ensure good rations and benefits for himself, while the rest of the base was forced to survive on meager supplies. When one of the base's supply ships was set to leave for the nearest supply depot, Wek noticed that one of the ship's engines was damaged. Gardit, however, dismissed her concerns and allowed the ship to leave.<ref name="Prove">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Prove Gardit's Corruption|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref> The ship had barely lifted off when it crashed in a nearby swamp infested with [[bogstalker]]s.<ref name="Supplies" />

{{GameLS}}
When Gardit asked a Republic-allied individual to help recover the supplies from the downed craft, he sent them to Wek for the location of the crash.<ref name="Supplies" /> Informing the individual of her suspicions of Gardit, the Twi'lek convinced the individual to help expose her superior. She gave the individual a holocamera along with the ship's location, telling them to record the damaged engine as evidence.<ref name="Prove" />

The individual succeeded, recovering all of the supplies that remained,<ref name="Supplies" /> and returned to Wek with the evidence she needed. She and the individual then confronted Gardit, who shamefacedly told the pair that he had not realized the ship was that badly damaged&mdash;he thought it could make it to the nearest refueling station. Regardless, Wek planned to court-martial the commander, and thanked the individual for the help.<ref name="Prove" />

She also asked them to investigate the fates of the supply convoy that the base had sent to Waypoint Station Morne a week ago. The convoy's crew had not reported anything, and Morne had not received the supplies. She told the individual how to repair the sonic emitters along the trail, which would drive off much of the aggressive wildlife, and gave them the last known location of the convoy. The individual would eventually find the convoy, who had decided to desert, and aided them in getting off-planet.<ref name="AWOL">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|AWOL|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kahrin Wek was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears first as part of the Republic Taris mission "Supplies and Demands," but can also give the bonus mission "Prove Gardit's Corruption." Both missions, as they appear on the Republic version of the planet, are restricted to Republic players, but players do have alignment options. Players can gather the evidence for Wek and complete "Prove Gardit's Corruption," and they can choose whether or not to give the recording to Wek. Giving her the recording and supporting her against Gardit results in light-side points, while siding with Gardit results in dark side points.<ref name="Supplies" />

Wek also starts the mission "AWOL" after the completion of "Supplies and Demands," where she asks Republic players to search for the missing convoy. This quest ends with Commander [[Yajak]] in Waypoint Station Morne.<ref name="AWOL" />
